title: Dental PPO Plans Coinsurance of the Requested Payment on Second-Level Claim Appeals
content:
**Rule.** On a second-level post-service appeal of the Dental PPO Plans under the claim-appeal rule, the coinsurance the requested payment is figured at follows the network status of the line under appeal, and so decides the amount in dispute: a basic-class line from an out-of-network practice is figured at the plan's out-of-network basic percentage; a major-class line from an out-of-network practice is figured at the plan's out-of-network major percentage; any other line is figured at the plan's in-network percentage for its service class.

| Plan | Out-of-network basic | Out-of-network major | In-network preventive | In-network basic | In-network major |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Preventive 750 | 0 | 0 | 100 | 0 | 0 |
| Value 1000 | 60 | 0 | 100 | 70 | 0 |
| Classic 1250 | 70 | 40 | 100 | 80 | 50 |
| Plus 1500 | 80 | 50 | 100 | 80 | 50 |
| Premier 2000 | 80 | 50 | 100 | 90 | 60 |
| Elite 2500 | 90 | 60 | 100 | 90 | 60 |

(percentages)

**Q.** A major line from an out-of-network practice under appeal on Elite 2500? **A.** 60 percent, the out-of-network major figure; in network it would also be 60 percent.
**Q.** A preventive line from an out-of-network practice? **A.** It is "any other line": the in-network preventive figure, 100 percent.
